entries.title: Coffer in the system file picker
entries.description: Apps such as KeePassDX can open vault files through Android's file picker and save them back. Off by default: Settings, Security.

entries.title: Edit in another app
entries.description: An editor changes a decrypted copy, and each save goes back into the vault in place of the file.

entries.title: A name already taken asks what to do
entries.description: Replace, Keep both or Skip for a file, Merge for a folder, with a tick to do the same for the rest. Settings, Storage, sets what happens without asking.

entries.title: The video seek bar shows what is loaded
entries.description: In grey under the part played.

entries.title: Changes keep going when Coffer is closed
entries.description: Creating, renaming, moving and deleting go through the transfer queue and show in Transfers, with Telegram's pauses counted down.

entries.title: Fewer of Telegram's pauses
entries.description: Several changes go in one message, so a folder of many folders is a few messages. This is a new version of the vault format: update every device that opens the vault.

entries.title: Lock in the top bar
entries.description: A padlock beside search. Locking with it no longer brings up fingerprint unlock by itself.

entries.title: Smoother lock and unlock
entries.description: The files stay in place while the padlock flies, and fade in once they are read after unlocking.

entries.title: A security audit of everything new
entries.description: Four independent reviews of all that changed since 1.0.0; every finding is fixed or explained. The report: https://github.com/Esdex/Coffer/blob/main/audits/SECURITY_AUDIT_2026-11-20.md

entries.title: PDF zoom follows your fingers
entries.description: A pinch zooms about the place between the fingers, and drags and pinches no longer fight.

entries.title: The path bar in the normal theme
entries.description: It has the bar's background; the list no longer shows through it.

entries.title: First release
entries.description: An encrypted vault in your Telegram Saved Messages, with viewers for photos, videos, music, PDFs and text, folders, offline files and fingerprint unlock.
